source.title: Sr Manager, Advanced Manufacturing Technology. Global
source.description:
**Position Purpose**

The Senior Manager leads the global Advanced Manufacturing Technology (AMT) organization and converts long-range technical direction into an executable three-to-five-year portfolio of technology, automation, equipment, and factory-transformation initiatives.

The role owns people leadership, portfolio execution, global capital-process stewardship, strategic vendor and technical-equipment vendor portfolio management, deployment, adoption, and business results.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Strategy and Portfolio Leadership**

Translate enterprise strategy and technical direction into an executable AMT roadmap.

Prioritize initiatives using business value, readiness, risk, capacity, and strategic alignment.

Drive results across functions, regions, and multiple levels.

**Global Capital Process Custodianship**

Serve as custodian of the global capital process, including standard work, governance, review cadence, documentation quality, portfolio transparency, and continuous improvement.

Develop and quality-review investment plans, business cases, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).

Provide the Vice President portfolio analysis and recommendations supporting global capital strategy and prioritization.

Manage assigned capital and operating budgets and ensure financial adherence.

**Global Vendor and Technical Equipment Portfolio**

Lead strategic relationships with key global manufacturing-technology and equipment vendors.

Create and maintain the technical equipment vendor portfolio, including preferred capabilities, technology coverage, performance, quality, delivery, risk, capacity, lifecycle support, and regional applicability.

Lead supplier development, technical reviews, commercial alignment, long-term service strategies, and executive escalation.

Use global portfolio leverage to improve standardization, innovation access, total cost, delivery, and support.

**Technology Deployment and Results**

Lead programs from concept approval through industrialization, qualification, deployment, adoption, and benefits realization.

Establish accountability for scope, schedule, budget, risk, and measurable outcomes.

Remove organizational barriers and ensure consistent execution across regions.

**Organization and Talent**

Lead, coach, and develop.

Build morale, productivity, innovation, learning, succession, and accountability.

**AMT Expansion Playbook**

Create and maintain the AMT expansion playbook covering organizational, people, technical, process, specification, vendor, equipment, installation, qualification, training, and readiness requirements.

Own the AMT workstream for expansion programs and ensure equipment and technology readiness at each stage gate.

**Nature and Scope**

The Senior Manager leads the global AMT organization with broad accountability for organizational capability, global capital-process stewardship, key vendor relationships, the technical-equipment vendor portfolio, technology investment execution, deployment, and measurable business outcomes across regions.

**Knowledge & Skills**

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor degree in Engineering required; advanced degree preferred.

12+ years in manufacturing technology, automation, industrialization, or related fields.

5+ years leading technical teams and complex cross-functional programs.

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

Manufacturing technologies, automation, controls, robotics, digital manufacturing, industrialization, equipment-vendor management, capital governance, and portfolio management.

Strong working knowledge of Lean and high-variation, low-volume manufacturing.

**Leadership & Business Competencies**

Compelling vision, stakeholder mobilization, financial acumen, talent development, change leadership, and three-to-five-year strategic planning.

**Working Conditions**

Office and manufacturing environments.

Standing and walking up to 50 percent; occasional lifting up to 30 pounds.

Domestic and international travel up to 30 percent.

 

BAC Hiring Compensation Range $133,300 - $228,600 
 
BAC offers a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401k, employee stock ownership plan, and more. Please see additional details on the BAC website at www.Baltimoreaircoil.com. 
 
BAC Employees are eligible to participate in an annual bonus incentive program.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

source.title: Head of Bedrock Operations Center
source.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD


At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver more of the critical infrastructure our society needs.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Head of Bedrock Operations Center (BOC) to build and lead the central, always-on hub that oversees our deployed autonomous machines. As the Bedrock System deployments scale across new states, new machine types, and a next-generation platform, the BOC is how we keep every machine safe, productive, and supported around the clock.

This role owns three core functions: Remote Assistance, supporting autonomous machines in real time when they need a human decision; Customer & Partner Support, the single front door for customers, partners, and field teams; and Central Operations, which provides live visibility, dispatch coordination, and incident coordination and command.

The Head of BOC owns the Operations Center's operating model, organization, tooling requirements, performance, and manpower oversight. The BOC is accountable for the safe remote operations, uptime, and responsiveness our customers experience. Reporting to the VP of Operations, this leader is a critical thought partner to Product and to Operations Leads across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Operations Center Strategy & Build-out

 - Define the BOC operating model, org structure, and coverage model (shifts, time zones, follow-the-sun) as the fleet scales

 - Build and lead the BOC leadership team and a growing workforce of shift leads and specialists

 - Own workforce planning and ensure adequate, qualified staffing; Partner with Product and Engineering on machines-per-operator ratios against fleet growth, product mix, and new machine types

 - Own the physical and technical readiness of the Operations Center, including infrastructure, redundancy, connectivity, and business continuity

Remote Assistance

 - Own round-the-clock remote operations for autonomous machines, including response-time SLAs, escalation protocols, and clear decision authority

 - Establish safety-first standards for remote interventions, remote stops, and hand-offs to on-site personnel, in partnership with Safety teams

 - Build training, certification, and quality-assurance programs for remote assistance operators

 - Analyze intervention data and partner with Autonomy Engineering to reduce interventions and improve machine autonomy over time

Customer & Partner Support

 - Build and lead a tiered support function (L1 / L2 / L3) with clear escalation paths into Field Operations, Service, Hardware, RA, and/ or Engineering

 - Define and deliver support SLAs tailored to each product line and customer commitment

 - Own ticketing, knowledge base, and customer communication standards; turn voice-of-customer trends into fixes

 - Partner with the Commercial team on customer onboarding, service commitments, and account health

Central Operations / Command & Control

 - Own live, fleet-wide situational awareness: machine status, health, location, and utilization across every site

 - Coordinate daily dispatch, service, and maintenance with Field Operations, including parts and technician routing

 - Serve as incident command for operational and safety events, with clear playbooks for triage, escalation, communication, and post-incident review

 - Own runbooks, shift hand-off standards, and change management for new sites, new machine types, and new platforms

Performance & Analytics

 - Define and track core BOC metrics: intervention rate and response time, resolution time, SLA attainment, fleet uptime, customer satisfaction, and cost to serve

 - Run operational review cadences that drive accountability and bring key insights to leadership

 - Lead continuous improvement through process, automation, and data, increasing the number of machines each operator can safely support


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Autonomous machines get fast, safe human support whenever they need it

 - Customers and partners have one clear front door and consistently fast resolution

 - Real-time visibility into every machine and site, with incidents handled calmly and transparently

 - Machines-per-operator rises steadily as intervention insights drive autonomy improvements

 - The Operations Center scales ahead of fleet growth, new sites, and new machine types without a drop in service


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

 - 12+ years in operations leadership, including 5+ years building and leading 24/7 or mission-critical operations (command centers, remote operations, network or fleet operations, or large-scale support organizations)

 - Experience building an operations organization from early stage to scale, including hiring and developing managers and shift leads and managing large hourly and/or contract workforces

 - Track record defining and managing SLAs, escalation paths, and incident response in safety-critical or high-availability environments

 - Experience influencing engineering, product, and commercial leaders, driving difficult decisions, and managing risk through rapid growth

 - Strong analytical skills; comfortable with operational data, dashboards, and forecasting models (SQL / BI tools a plus)

 - Experience with workforce planning, scheduling, and shift-based operations

 - Excellent written and verbal communication with customers, field crews, and executives

Preferred

 - Experience running operations centers for autonomous vehicles, robotics, trucking, aviation, or mining

 - Experience leading remote assistance, teleoperation, or fleet response teams for autonomous systems

 - Familiarity with heavy machinery and/or the construction industry

 - Experience building B2B or technical support for industrial equipment or hardware products

 - Familiarity with fleet telemetry, monitoring and alerting, ticketing, and workforce-management tools

 - Experience launching operations across multiple regions or time zones

 - Continuous improvement / Lean / Six Sigma experience


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Every autonomous machine Bedrock deploys depends on the Operations Center to keep it safe, productive, and supported. You'll build the function that lets our fleet scale with confidence, and directly shape the experience every customer and partner has with Bedrock.

Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodations

We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.
